output.reason: PMK 66/2023 makes benefits in kind (natura/kenikmatan) received by employees in connection with employment part of taxable income, so they enter the PPh 21 gross income of permanent employees. It also sets exclusions, such as meal coupons up to Rp2,000,000 per month and region-specific facilities, and it sets the valuation rules (market value or cost) and the timing of withholding. Withholding applies from the July 2023 tax period; natura received in January–June 2023 is excluded from withholding and the recipient must self-assess the tax due.
